Ptot, DVPE and tank-homogeneity review

Fort Worth decision rule: the tool recalculates DVPE from Ptot using DVPE = 0.956 × Ptot − 0.347 psi. A laboratory specification or laboratory-calculated DVPE is retained as evidence but does not control the release decision.

Evidence
SPL Certificate of Analysis
Upload the returned SPL CoA. The original report is retained with the case. SPL’s printed specification and disposition are advisory; Global Partners independently evaluates SPL’s measured Ptot values using the Fort Worth limits and current EPA equation.
No CoA attached.

  
Decision posture: Fort Worth is fixed to the DFW RFG profile. The Compliance-managed Fort Worth release profile requires every upper, middle, and lower internal EPA DVPE result to be ≤ 9.00 psi and the E10 runner to be ≤ 10.00 psi. The upper/middle/lower spread is a Fort Worth tank-homogeneity check; never duplicate a missing position to satisfy it. No precision allowance is applied and results exactly at the limit pass. SPL’s printed limits and Pass/Fail disposition are advisory; Global Partners’ release determination on SPL’s measured results controls the case.

Compliance administration
Restricted configuration. This terminal-wide authority record is maintained outside the operator blend workflow. Operations receives only an automatic release-authorization status and is never asked to interpret or update waiver information during a blend.

  
Verified authority record

  
Blend RVP target
Terminal blend DVPE target used for butane dosing and margin capture. Set here by Compliance only — operations cannot change it during a blend. Validated against the RVP ceiling in effect for the chosen date; targeting above the ceiling is allowed with a warning so product can be pre-blended to the next volatility level and held for later release.

  





  
Per-blend target override
Requires PQ manager approval. The compliance-set terminal target governs every blend by default. On an individual case it can only be increased here, and only with a recorded PQ manager approval and attestation. It cannot be lowered below the compliance default, and it locks once the load plan is confirmed and trucks are ordered. Increases are validated against the RVP ceiling for the effective date; above-ceiling values are allowed with a warning so product can be pre-blended to the next volatility level and held.
